identity.name: Seigaiha 38mm Blue Dial
identity.one_liner: Kurono Tokyo's hand-finished 38mm dress watch with a 5-layer Urushi lacquer dial — a small-batch indie from the Lowther family (Grand Seiko veterans), sold by lottery at sub-$2k.

provenance_events.description: Hajime Ishikawa (former Grand Seiko designer) launches Kurono Tokyo Seigaiha — a 38mm dress watch with a 5-layer Urushi lacquer dial, sold by lottery.

narrative.story: Kurono Tokyo is the indie line of Hajime Ishikawa, who spent a decade at Grand Seiko before going independent. The Seigaiha is his most-photographed piece: a 38mm steel dress watch with a 5-layer Urushi lacquer dial.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial is hand-applied Urushi lacquer over a guilloché base — each layer takes 24 hours to cure.
